seo.description: The Economy Testing & Research Laboratory (ETRL) test reports for six Govind Madhav herbal teas, issued 7 September 2022.

hero.title: Laboratory Test Reports
hero.lead: Explore the laboratory test reports for our herbal tea collections. We believe in transparency and providing customers with access to product-related testing information.

intro.title: Quality Information You Can Explore
intro.lead: Explore the laboratory test reports associated with Govind Madhav Herbal Tea products. Each report presents the chemical parameters tested by Economy Testing & Research Laboratory (ETRL).
intro.body: Each one-page report lists the energy value, fats, cholesterol, sodium, potassium, carbohydrate, dietary fibre, sugar, protein, vitamins A and C, calcium and iron measured in the tea, per 1 g serving, with the method reference for each test.
intro.note: As each report states, its results relate only to the sample tested. Samples were received on 3 September 2022 and the reports were issued on 7 September 2022.
